ns2:section.sectionText: 2 hours PERSONAL FINANCIAL PLANNING - Reserved for Seniors only. A survey of the financial planning process and industry, this course covers investment, tax, insurance, and retirement planning. Applicable to those interested in creating a sound personal financial plan early in one's working career and those interested in becoming a financial planner. A special emphasis is put on real-world solution: Asset allocation, spreadsheets, Monte Carlo simulations, etc. Class meets 22-Aug-2007 thru 12-Oct-2007.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
